quranTranslation.text: The messenger believeth in that which hath been revealed unto him from his Lord and (so do) believers. Each one believeth in Allah and His angels and His scriptures and His messengers - We make no distinction between any of His messengers - and they say: We hear, and we obey. (Grant us) Thy forgiveness, our Lord. Unto Thee is the journeying.

explanation.bs: Poslanik i vjernici vjeruju u Allaha, meleke, knjige i poslanike – predmet imana.
explanation.en: The Messenger and the believers believe in Allah, His angels, books and messengers — the objects of faith.

quranTranslation.text: O ye who believe! Believe in Allah and His messenger and the Scripture which He hath revealed unto His messenger, and the Scripture which He revealed aforetime. Whoso disbelieveth in Allah and His angels and His scriptures and His messengers and the Last Day, he verily hath wandered far astray.

explanation.bs: „O vi koji vjerujete, vjerujte…“ – vjernicima se naređuje da vjeruju: iman se obnavlja i jača.
explanation.en: “O ye who believe! Believe…” — believers bidden to believe: faith renewed and strengthened.

quranTranslation.text: When his Lord said unto him: Surrender! he said: I have surrendered to the Lord of the Worlds.

explanation.bs: „Predaj se!“ – „Predao sam se Gospodaru svjetova“ – Ibrahimova potpuna predanost, islam iznad imana.
explanation.en: “Surrender!” — “I have surrendered to the Lord of the Worlds” — Ibrāhīm's complete submission, islām above īmān.

quranTranslation.text: Who is better in religion than he who surrendereth his purpose to Allah while doing good (to men) and followeth the tradition of Abraham, the upright? Allah (Himself) chose Abraham for friend.

explanation.bs: Najbolji u vjeri je onaj ko lice svoje preda Allahu čineći dobro.
explanation.en: Best in religion is the one who submits his face to Allah while doing good.

quranTranslation.text: And who believe in that which is revealed unto thee (Muhammad) and that which was revealed before thee, and are certain of the Hereafter.

explanation.bs: „I u ahiret su oni čvrsto uvjereni“ – uvjerenje u ahiret.
explanation.en: “And are certain of the Hereafter” — conviction in the hereafter.

quranTranslation.text: And in your creation, and all the beasts that He scattereth in the earth, are portents for a folk whose faith is sure.

explanation.bs: U stvaranju živih bića su znakovi za ljude koji su čvrsto uvjereni.
explanation.en: “In your creation, and all the beasts that He scattereth in the earth, are portents for a folk whose faith is sure.”

quranTranslation.text: And when they became steadfast and believed firmly in Our revelations, We appointed from among them leaders who guided by Our command.

explanation.bs: Predvodnici koji su bili strpljivi i u Naše ajete čvrsto vjerovali.
explanation.en: Leaders who were patient and were certain of Our signs.

quranTranslation.text: He said: They are close upon my track. I hastened unto Thee, my Lord, that Thou mightest be well pleased.

explanation.bs: Musa: „A ja sam Ti požurio, Gospodaru moj, da bi Ti bio zadovoljan“ – ar-Rāġib: žurba s hvale vrijednim povodom.
explanation.en: Moses: “I hastened unto Thee, my Lord, that Thou mightest be well pleased” — ar-Rāġib: haste with a praised motive.

gloss.en: to hasten, to be in haste

quranTranslation.text: Then exalted be Allah, the True King! And hasten not (O Muhammad) with the Qur'an ere its revelation hath been perfected unto thee, and say: My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.

explanation.bs: „I nemoj žuriti s Kur'anom dok ti se njegova objava ne dovrši“ – ne prije vremena.
explanation.en: “And hasten not (O Muhammad) with the Qur'an ere its revelation hath been perfected unto thee” — not before its time.

gloss.en: to hasten, to be in haste

quranTranslation.text: So make no haste against them (O Muhammad). We do but number unto them a sum (of days).

explanation.bs: „Zato ne žuri da ih stigne kazna; Mi im samo brojimo dane“ – sve ima svoj rok.
explanation.en: “So make no haste against them (O Muhammad). We do but number unto them a sum (of days)” — everything has its term.

gloss.en: to hasten, to be in haste

quranTranslation.text: The commandment of Allah will come to pass, so seek not ye to hasten it. Glorified and Exalted be He above all that they associate (with Him).

explanation.bs: „Allahova odredba je stigla, zato je ne požurujte!“
explanation.en: “The commandment of Allah will come to pass, so seek not ye to hasten it.”

gloss.en: to ask to hasten, to be impatient for

quranTranslation.text: And they will bid thee hasten on the Doom, and Allah faileth not His promise, but lo! a Day with Allah is as a thousand years of what ye reckon.

explanation.bs: „I požuruju te s kaznom“ – poricatelji požuruju kaznu.
explanation.en: “And they will bid thee hasten on the Doom” — the deniers hurrying the punishment.

gloss.en: to ask to hasten, to be impatient for

quranTranslation.text: He said: O my people! Why will ye hasten on the evil rather than the good? Why will ye not ask pardon of Allah, that ye may receive mercy.

explanation.bs: Salih: „O narode moj, zašto tražite da zlo dođe brže nego dobro?“
explanation.en: Ṣāliḥ: “O my people! Why will ye hasten on the evil rather than the good?”

gloss.en: to ask to hasten, to be impatient for

quranTranslation.text: And vie one with another for forgiveness from your Lord, and for a paradise as wide as are the heavens and the earth, prepared for those who ward off (evil);

explanation.bs: „I hitajte ka oprostu od svoga Gospodara“ – hvaljeno hitanje.
explanation.en: “And vie one with another for forgiveness from your Lord” — praised hastening.

quranTranslation.text: These race for the good things, and they shall win them in the race.

explanation.bs: „Takvi hitaju u dobrim djelima i oni u njima prednjače.“
explanation.en: “These race for the good things, and they shall win them in the race.”

quranTranslation.text: And thou seest many of them vying one with another in sin and transgression and their devouring of illicit gain. Verily evil is what they do.

explanation.bs: „I vidiš mnoge od njih kako hitaju u grijeh i nasilje“ – kuđeno hitanje.
explanation.en: “And thou seest many of them vying one with another in sin and transgression” — blamed hastening.

quranTranslation.text: And if ye do it not - and ye can never do it - then guard yourselves against the Fire prepared for disbelievers, whose fuel is of men and stones.

explanation.bs: „… pa se čuvajte Vatre čije su gorivo ljudi i kamenje …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi tri mišljenja: sumporno kamenje; pravo kamenje, čime se ukazuje na veličinu te Vatre, jer se ovosvjetska vatra kamenjem ne loži; ili ljudi tvrdi poput kamena u odbijanju istine.
explanation.en: “then guard yourselves against the Fire prepared for disbelievers, whose fuel is of men and stones” — ar-Rāġib reports three views: sulphur stones; the stones themselves, which points to how great that Fire is, for the fire of this world is not kindled with stones; or people as hard as stones in refusing the truth.

quranTranslation.text: That we may send upon them stones of clay,

explanation.bs: Meleki Ibrahimu o Lutovu narodu: „da na njih pošaljemo kamenje od gline“ – kamenje kao kazna.
explanation.en: The angels to Abraham about Lot's people: “That we may send upon them stones of clay” — stones as punishment.

quranTranslation.text: Say: Be ye stones or iron

explanation.bs: „Reci: ‚Budite kamenje ili željezo‘“ – kamen kao slika tvrde, beživotne tvari.
explanation.en: “Say: Be ye stones or iron” — stone as the image of hard, lifeless matter.

quranTranslation.text: O my dear son! Lo! though it be but the weight of a grain of mustard-seed, and though it be in a rock, or in the heavens, or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Lo! Allah is Subtile, Aware.

explanation.bs: Lukman sinu: „… pa makar bilo u stijeni, ili na nebesima, ili u zemlji, Allah će ga iznijeti …“ – ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: Luqman to his son: “and though it be in a rock, or in the heavens, or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth” — ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley;

explanation.bs: „i sa Semudom, koji su klesali stijene u dolini“ – stijena tvrda za klesanje; ar-Rāġib navodi ovaj ajet.
explanation.en: “And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley” — rock hard to hew; ar-Rāġib cites this ayah.

quranTranslation.text: He said: Didst thou see, when we took refuge on the rock, and I forgot the fish - and none but Satan caused me to forget to mention it - it took its way into the waters by a marvel.

explanation.bs: Mladić Musau: „Jesi li vidio kad smo se sklonili kod stijene …“
explanation.en: The young man to Moses: “Didst thou see, when we took refuge on the rock”
